For these kinds of accessibility descriptions where the difference is basically a new line, I wonder if you could have them borrow from the same source. For example (pseudocode):
```c++
String first_line = TTRC("Toggle preview sunlight.")
sun_button->set_accessibility_name(first_line)
sun_button->set_tooltip_text(first_line + "\n" + TTRC("If a DirectionalLight3D node is added to the scene, preview sunlight is disabled."))
```

It may be confusing for translations, though

Nitpick: "Fallback" is the noun, "fall back" is the action.
